passage:
debris — 碎片，残骸
Meanwhile, a group of local fishermen, including Tomás Herrera, reported that their nets were catching fewer fish and more debris.

microplastics — 微塑料
A turning point came when a university research team published a study showing that microplastics had entered the local food chain.

peer-reviewed — 经过同行评审的
Aisha Patel, was not without limitations: it relied on a small sample and had not yet been peer-reviewed.

pilot — 试验性的
Mayor Ruiz proposed a pilot project to install floating barriers at the mouth of the bay.

bycatch — 副渔获物
These changes reduced the bycatch, but the barriers still required frequent maintenance.

biodegradable — 可生物降解的
The group, founded by a retired teacher, Clara Nguyen, organized workshops and persuaded several restaurants to switch to biodegradable containers.

transferable — 可转移的，可推广的
As a result, the visitors concluded that while the barrier project could be adapted, the plastic-reduction campaign might be more transferable, because it required fewer resources.

silver bullet — 灵丹妙药，万全之策
"The barriers were not a silver bullet, but they taught us how to experiment and adapt.
